blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Internal communication is how the company talks to its own people. It can be by email, by video, by meeting or by a simple message on the intranet.

Good communication is clear, short and friendly. When people know what is happening, they feel part of the team.

Good internal communication brings people together. It builds trust and helps everyone work as one team.

items.q: What is internal communication?
options: How the company sells to clients
How the company hires new people
How the company talks to its own people
How the company pays its bills
items.why: "Internal communication is how the company talks to its own people."

items.q: According to the text, good communication is…
items.why: "Good communication is clear, short and friendly."

items.q: How can the company share a message?
options: By email, video, meeting or the intranet
items.why: "It can be by email, by video, by meeting or by a simple message on the intranet."

items.q: The text suggests that when people know what is happening, they…
items.why: Inferência: "they feel part of the team" — saber o que acontece gera pertencimento.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: clear communication helps a team trust each other
long and difficult messages are best
communication is not important at work
items.why: Inferência: o texto liga boa comunicação a confiança e a trabalhar como um só time.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver gravando um vídeo curto para toda a empresa. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi everyone, this is Oliver. Thank you for watching this short video. I have some good news to share about a new project.

Next month we start a new project called Green Office. The goal is simple: use less paper and save energy in every team. It is a small change, but it helps a lot.

Here is what you need to know. First, we will send an announcement by email this Friday. Please read it. Second, we will have a short meeting on Monday to answer your questions. And third, you can find all the updates on the intranet, in the news page.

I know we all get many emails every day. So I want this message to be clear and short. If you have a question, just send me a message on the chat. I read all of them.

Thank you for your time. Let's work together and make this project a success. See you on Monday!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the name of the new project?
items.why: "a new project called Green Office."

items.q: What is the goal of the project?
options: To use less paper and save energy
items.why: "use less paper and save energy in every team."

items.q: When will Oliver send the announcement?
items.why: "we will send an announcement by email this Friday."

items.q: Why does Oliver want the message to be short?
options: Because he does not like videos
Because he is in a hurry
Because the project is a secret
Because people already get many emails every day
items.why: Inferência: "I know we all get many emails every day. So I want this message to be clear and short."

items.q: How would you best describe Oliver's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele agradece, dá boas notícias e convida o time a trabalhar junto.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We will send an announcement to all teams tomorrow." An announcement is…
items.why: Announcement = comunicado: uma mensagem pública com uma novidade.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please read the company ___ on the intranet every week."
items.why: Newsletter = boletim, que se lê na intranet.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I like to ___ good news with my team."
items.why: To share = compartilhar.

items.q: "We put all company updates on the intranet." The intranet is…
items.why: Intranet = a rede/site interno da empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good message is ___ , so everyone understands it fast."
items.why: Clear = claro, fácil de entender.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em comunicação de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you send out the announcement to everyone?" To send out means to…
options: distribute a message to many people
items.why: Send out = enviar/distribuir para muitas pessoas.

items.q: "Let's catch up in a short meeting on Monday." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar o papo em dia, trocar novidades.

items.q: "Please keep me posted about the new project." This means…
options: send me a letter by post
wait for me at the door
items.why: Keep me posted = me mantenha informado.

items.q: "I will reach out to the team by email." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato com alguém.

items.q: "Let's roll out the new plan next month." To roll out means to…
options: start the plan step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos, colocar em prática.
